obligations.obligation: Name an owner-callable coordinator input-cancellation method that reaches the actual renderer while an operation is active. It must not use the normal operation-entry or idle-disposal path. Ordinary input, engine create/prepare/commit/abort/destroy, renderer disposal and transaction completion are forbidden in this bridge.

obligations.obligation: State that shared terminal/draw/input authority and actual current/pending gate flags close before any cancellation callback, native setter, core allocation, queue removal or cleanup. Terminal sealing sets terminal first; dirty sealing must not terminally retire a healthy lifetime. The scalar barrier has no callback, allocation, collection walk or sink dispatch.

obligations.obligation: Freeze the bounded record roster being cancelled and when that roster becomes owned. Account for current records, pending targets/detached records, shared identities and a candidate under preparation before publication. A fixed-roster claim cannot mean a mutable live collection that reentry replaces, an unbounded history, or a list constructed after a fatal allocation failure. State which prepublication records can own active input and why excluded records cannot.

obligations.note: Contract requirement reviewed; future implementation behavior remains unrun.
obligations.obligation: Publish in-progress/claimed/consumed ownership before callbacks. Reentrant dirty or terminal notifications cannot recursively traverse the same roster, restart consumed cancellation or skip independently owned resources. State how an invalidation during cancellation remains dirty and receives at most one later drain. If counters/generations are introduced, exhaustion fails closed before wrap; do not invent accepted core tokens or require a new counter when flags suffice.

obligations.obligation: Retain attempted/returned/failed/deferred/uncertain outcomes and first ordinary failure plus first fatal Error in bounded preallocated diagnostics. Ordinary cancellation failure terminally retires the lifetime; fatal Error escapes after independent cleanup attempts. Keep toggle cancellation distinct from Handler CANCEL_QUEUED.

A shared opening/adopted coordinator identity must not receive duplicate dispositions. Internally retired coordinator outcomes must be borrowed rather than repeated.
